Personnel: Hamilton
Colonel and commanding officer of County Hillock Barracks, an ordinary citizen with no involvement in any power struggles. Holds a firm and aggressive stance towards people of Taran background. He is on high alert, and decapitation operations are not advised.
On the evening of the 12th, he dined with two Messengers at the Waterside Restaurant, lip reading reveals that they were dispatched by a certain Count.
...
As expected, all attempts at communication have failed. It can now be confirmed that the Oripathy crisis in County Hillock has been artificially exacerbated. Someone is stoking his hatred behind the scenes and using his stubborn and self-centered personality to test the Duke of Wellington's stance. The battle plan has taken shape, and the image contains a telegram sent to the barracks on an outlying plate.
This calls for a requisite disclosure of information to him in order to reduce suspicion on me from within the military apparatus.

Personnel: Count Mourning
Intends to defect to the Duke of Wellington. His demesne is near to Londinium, and a large quantity of Originium product orders have been flowing in. Based on the volume, he has the military prowess to stand firm against the various units outside Londinium.
He and his wife share a love of Bolívarian coffee, taking regular trips to purchase the beans in person. His children are not yet of age, and his eldest daughter attended a private secondary school in the Auchterigg Borough of Londinium until departing last year.
Signature and handwriting can be seen in the image.
...
He is on good terms with the Skamandros family, and most of his trusted aides also have respect for the White Wolf Count. Rita may be a crucial bargaining chip. If Mandragora brings Rita with her to negotiate a collaboration, the process should go smoother. After all, he would not want to see anything happen to his friend's daughter. Time is limited, we will need to push him to make a decision and agree to help Dublinn infiltrate Londinium.

Organization: 'Rhodes Island'
The medical organization that made off with Loughshinny. They're registered in Victoria and have four drug patents pertaining to Oripathy.
...

'The remaining pages are all about you, so you've no need to scrutinize them any further, right?'
'I've been at it for nearly a year now, and this is the only information I've gathered. I have to compliment your clandestine work.'
'The intelligence I'm offering you is only the lovingly curated fraction that is beneficial to the both of us. Whether or not I've fabricated anything is up to you to determine.'
'...Come now, have I not been sufficiently pacifist in my methods?'
'After all, I've never picked anyone out as an enemy, and I don't particularly enjoy seeing people sacrifice themselves.'
'I just like to push people in the right direction and listen as those contradictory bits form their own harmony.'
